definitions.unique_and_correct: Exactly one semantic match and its mask reaches the IoU threshold.
definitions.wrong_unique: Exactly one semantic match but its mask is below the IoU threshold.
definitions.correct_in_review_set_given_ambiguous: Among queries with multiple semantic matches, at least one match reaches the IoU threshold.
definitions.unresolved: No exported identity matches the semantic query.

reference_usage: Reference part masks are used only for this post-hoc routing audit and were not supplied to proposal generation, HPID fusion, or semantic query resolution.
